opportunities.name: Ultimatum on-hit lock
opportunities.objective: Test ultimatum on-hit lock against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Hextech Ultimatum adds current-health magic damage to Camille's attacks for 2.5-4 seconds; Hookshot grants five seconds of attack speed. Blade and Terminus reward attacking inside that short isolation window rather than maximizing one delayed Q.
opportunities.requiredState: Hit E and R, then stay in attack range through the trap.
opportunities.failure: Short R duration and outside peel prevent stacking attack effects.
opportunities.test: Count ordinary attacks and R magic packets during a full rank-three cage.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Q2 true conversion cannot be assumed to convert all purchased on-hit packets.

opportunities.name: Sweep shield sustain
opportunities.objective: Test sweep shield sustain against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Tactical Sweep's outer hit heals from bonus max-health physical damage, while Adaptive Defenses shields from Camille's max health. Bloodmail and Trinity add AD and a separate Spellblade attack; Visage supports shields and healing between spaced Q casts.
opportunities.requiredState: Keep enemies at W outer edge and delay Q2 at least 1.5 seconds.
opportunities.failure: Point-blank dives lose W healing and mismatched damage can bypass the passive shield.
opportunities.test: Compare shield size and healing after two outer-W trades.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: No claim that Sundered Sky's forced crit multiplies Q2's converted true component.

ruledOut.reason: Q2 true conversion cannot be assumed to convert all purchased on-hit packets.

unknowns: Item and ability proc attribution requires a controlled current-patch test; symbolic statFormula and source flags are not runtime verification.

testPlan: Required state: Hit E and R, then stay in attack range through the trap.
Count ordinary attacks and R magic packets during a full rank-three cage.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Short R duration and outside peel prevent stacking attack effects.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Q2 true conversion cannot be assumed to convert all purchased on-hit packets.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blade of The Ruined King, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Titanic Hydra, Sterak's Gage, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
